# Draft:The TikTok Organisation of Taking Down the US Government

The TikTok Organisation of Taking Down The US Government is an organisation based in TikTok made to defy the corrupt law. The account was made in 2025 in Adelaide, South Australia.
The account has a few videos, all consisting of backgrounds from the games, Manhunt and Manhunt 2.
